# Confirmatory Analysis - Prep

## Read data

```{r}
dat <- fromJSON(
  data_path,
  simplifyVector = FALSE
) #do not view dat, it will crash

SPAM_IDS <- c(
  "ZNBZd7", "22EDKR", "AMRKB5", "2CJGWA", "McANR2", "R5dVKM",
  "RQCJLU", "A3ESRd", "VUGDDS", "QUF5ZS", "5HA7R5", "E4SEBD",
  "DSVC6M", "KPc32Z", "JTHHMT", "cKSVZR", "4Hc4L5", "GQAC2c",
  "MPXMDG", "NW3GDF", "LLRBS5"
)

# dat_extracted <- dat %>%
dat_extracted <- dat %>%
  discard(function(rec) {
    child_id <- rec$child$hashed_id %||% NA_character_
    participant_id <- rec$participant$hashed_id %||% NA_character_

    child_id %in% SPAM_IDS | participant_id %in% SPAM_IDS
  }) %>%
  # map_dfr(function(rec) {
  map_dfr(function(rec) {
    #one-row tibble of record-level metadata
    base_info <- tibble(
      response_id        = rec$response$id           %||% NA,
      response_uuid      = rec$response$uuid         %||% NA,
      response_date      = rec$response$date_created %||% NA,
      study_uuid         = rec$study$uuid            %||% NA,
      participant_id     = rec$participant$hashed_id %||% NA,
      child_id           = rec$child$hashed_id       %||% NA,
      child_age_rounded  = rec$child$age_rounded     %||% NA,
      child_gender       = rec$child$gender          %||% NA,
    )
    #extract exp_data
    rec$exp_data %||% list() %>%
      #drop empty records
      discard(~ length(.x) == 0) %>% 
      #iterate over frames
      imap_dfr(function(frame, frame_name) { 
        frame_row <- tibble(
          frame_name           = frame_name,
          frameType            = frame$frameType            %||% NA_character_,
          frameDuration        = frame$frameDuration        %||% NA_real_,
          videoShown           = frame$videoShown           %||% NA_character_,
          audioPlayed          = frame$audioPlayed %||% "" |> na_if(""),
          selectedImage        = frame$selectedImage        %||% NA_character_,
          correctImageSelected = frame$correctImageSelected %||% NA,
        )

        bind_cols(base_info, frame_row)
      })
  })

#filter date range
dat_extracted_filtered <- dat_extracted %>% 
  mutate(response_date = ymd_hms(response_date)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(response_date)) %>% 
  filter(response_date > ymd("2023-11-22")) %>% #11/22 was start date
  separate(frame_name, c("frame_number", "frame_label"), sep = "-", 
           extra = "merge", convert = TRUE) %>% 
  arrange(frame_number)

valid_ids <- dat_extracted_filtered %>%
  group_by(response_uuid, child_id) %>%
  summarise(
    has_condition_frame = any(frame_number == 11 & frame_label == "alexa-protocol" & !is.na(videoShown)),
    has_test_frame      = any(frame_number == 18 & frame_label == "alexa-protocol" & !is.na(selectedImage)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(has_condition_frame, has_test_frame)

dat_extracted_filtered_valid <- dat_extracted_filtered %>%
  semi_join(valid_ids, by = c("response_uuid", "child_id"))

# wrangle age
dat_age <- dat_extracted_filtered_valid %>% 
  mutate(child_age_rounded = as.numeric(child_age_rounded),
         child_gender = as.factor(child_gender),
         age = child_age_rounded / 365.2425,
         age = round(age, 2),
         age_floor = floor(age)) %>% 
  select(child_id, child_age_rounded, child_gender)

write.csv(dat_age, "data_with_gender.csv")

#n count
subj_count <- dat_age %>% 
  distinct(response_id) %>% 
  nrow()


subj_count

dat_extracted %>% 
  distinct(response_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  count(child_gender)


dat_counts <- dat %>%
  map_dfr(function(rec) {
    tibble(
      response_uuid = rec$response$uuid %||% NA,
      response_date = rec$response$date_created %||% NA,
      child_id = rec$child$hashed_id %||% NA,
      participant_id = rec$participant$hashed_id %||% NA,
      study_uuid = rec$study$uuid %||% NA,
      response_keys = paste(names(rec$response), collapse = ", ")
    )
  })

dat_counts %>%
  summarise(
    n_responses = n(),
    n_child_ids = n_distinct(child_id),
    n_response_uuids = n_distinct(response_uuid),
    n_studies = n_distinct(study_uuid)
  )

dat_counts %>%
  count(study_uuid, sort = TRUE)


dat_counts %>%
  count(child_id, sort = TRUE) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

valid_responses <- dat_extracted_filtered %>%
  group_by(response_id) %>%
  summarise(
    has_condition = any(frame_number == 11 & frame_label == "alexa-protocol" & !is.na(videoShown)),
    has_attn1     = any(frame_number == 12 & frame_label == "alexa-protocol" & !is.na(selectedImage)),
    has_attn2     = any(frame_number == 15 & frame_label == "alexa-protocol" & !is.na(selectedImage)),
    has_test      = any(frame_number == 18 & frame_label == "alexa-protocol" & !is.na(selectedImage)),
    has_attn3     = any(frame_number == 22 & frame_label == "null" & !is.na(selectedImage)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(has_condition, has_attn1, has_attn2, has_test, has_attn3)

dat_age_joined <- dat_age %>%
  semi_join(valid_responses, by = "response_id")

dat_age_joined 

dat_age_joined %>% 
  distinct(response_id) %>% 
  nrow()
```

  arrange(desc(response_date)) %>%
